hooks.command: command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'PEAgent: uv is not installed; see https://docs.astral.sh/uv/ (the peagent MCP server cannot start without it).'; exit 0; }; [ -x "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/.venv/bin/python" ] && exit 0; echo 'PEAgent: first run, installing the Python environment (1-5 min, once)...'; uv sync --quiet --python 3.11 --directory "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'PEAgent environment ready.' || echo 'PEAgent: environment install failed; run: uv sync --directory <plugin dir>'
